fullPassage: It is important to recognize that although science is a rule-based procedure, it is very much a creative process. A conjecture is a philosophical invention, cooked up rather mystically by the mind through the mental computation we call careful contemplation. However, until the hypothesis is tested against reality, it is not yet truly knowledge; it is just information that represents speculation. Knowledge is information that has demonstrated its usefulness. It is what is left over after cycles of experimental testing have eliminated false theories. As scientists continually test their hypotheses and modify their models to account for new and surprising data, a kind of 'learning loop' emerges that statisticians call Bayesian updating. Based on Bayes' Rule, developed by eighteenth-century English statistician and philosopher Thomas Bayes, Bayesian updating refers to a mathematical process whereby an accepted theory or predictive model gets increasingly accurate through the repetitive testing of competing variants of that theory.

questions.passage: It is important to recognize that ①<u>despite</u> science is a rule-based procedure, it is very much a creative process. A conjecture is a philosophical invention, ②<u>cooked</u> up rather mystically by the mind through the mental computation we call careful contemplation. However, until the hypothesis is tested against reality, it is not yet ③<u>truly</u> knowledge; it is just information that represents speculation. Knowledge is information that has demonstrated its usefulness. It is ④<u>what</u> is left over after cycles of experimental testing have eliminated false theories. As scientists continually test their hypotheses and modify their models to account for new and surprising data, a kind of 'learning loop' emerges that statisticians call Bayesian updating. Based on Bayes' Rule, developed by eighteenth-century English statistician and philosopher Thomas Bayes, Bayesian updating refers to a mathematical process whereby an accepted theory or predictive model gets increasingly accurate through the repetitive testing of competing variants of that theory.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 과학 = 가설→검증→수정→점진적 정확도 향상
det.analysis:
❌ ① 수정 금지: 본문은 modify(수정)를 강조. 정반대
✅ ② 반복적 검증+수정→점진적 정확성: 본문의 핵심 요지. learning loop + increasingly accurate ←정답
❌ ③ 통계학 필수: 베이지안 업데이팅은 예시이지 과학의 필수 조건으로 제시된 것이 아님
❌ ④ 직관만으로 지식: 본문은 직관(contemplation)으로 가설을 세우지만 검증이 필수라고 강조
det.tip: 요지: 과학 지식 = 가설 검증 + 모델 수정의 반복적 과정

ch: 과학적 가설은 한 번 세우면 절대 수정해서는 안 된다.

통계학적 방법 없이는 과학 연구가 불가능하다.
지식은 실험이 아닌 직관적 사고를 통해서만 얻을 수 있다.
